summary:
Iteration_10 (both) — Batch 4 (army skins, daily deal, full-screen skin preview, quick-chat). BACKEND (6/6 passed, /app/backend/tests/test_batch4_army_deal_quickchat.py, junit: /app/test_reports/pytest/batch4.xml): (1) Login qa.lord OK; GET /api/store/cosmetics returns 14 items (6 lord + 4 castle + 4 army, each with rubies_now); army entries include color/#RRGGBB + glow/#RRGGBB. (2) Daily deal shape verified: discount_pct=30, rubies==round(original*0.7), ends_at is next UTC midnight in the future within 24h; catalog rubies_now == deal.rubies for the deal SKU, == rubies for all others. Today's deal = castle_elven_palace (Palazzo Elfico) 490 rubies (700 → −30%), confirmed both in API and in shop UI. (3) POST /store/cosmetics/buy for the deal key deducted EXACTLY deal.rubies (490 → balance 3728→3238 in one live run, then 2878 after preview buy) and response {bought, equipped:true, rubies_spent:490, deal:true}. (4) POST /store/cosmetics/equip {kind:'army', key:'army_azure_order'} → 403 not_owned; {kind:'army', key:null} → 200 equipped=null and GET /profile cosmetics.army == null; re-equip army_crimson_legion → profile.cosmetics.army == {key:'army_crimson_legion', name:'Legione Cremisi', color:'#B3162B', glow:'#FF6A3D'}. (5) POST /store/cosmetics/equip {kind:'banner'} → 400 bad_kind. Teardown restores lord_frost_warden + castle_dragon_keep + army_crimson_legion.

FRONTEND (390x844 web preview, qa.lord logged in): Battle tab → battle-scene renders with the crimson army-banner (Legione Cremisi banner image + crimson/orange glow on the left of the formation) and formation-proxies use the crimson heraldic colour on the front-line unit banners (screenshot /tmp/it10_battle.png). Shop (opened via tab-events → hub-shop, url /shop): skin-shop container present; daily-deal card visible with -30% badge, name 'Palazzo Elfico', discounted 490 + struck-through 700, daily-deal-countdown text 'Scade tra 3h 37m' (matches next UTC midnight); skins-army section present with all 4 army cards (skin-army_crimson_legion / _azure_order / _emerald_wardens / _obsidian_pact). Legione Cremisi card shows 'Indossata' state. Full-screen preview: preview-lord_dragon_knight → skin-preview-screen, skin-preview-name='Cavaliere del Drago', skin-preview-lord animates through phases (screenshot A shows charge aura only, screenshot B ~1.6s later shows 'MOSSA SPECIALE' banner + dash pose + fire burst effects → scene clearly changes); skin-preview-buy shows '750  Acquista e indossa' with the rubies icon; skin-preview-close returns to shop. preview-army_crimson_legion → skin-preview-banner visible and skin-preview-equip button text='Indossata' with aria-disabled=true. preview-castle_winter_citadel → skin-preview-castle visible with fireworks. Buy from preview: preview-lord_crimson_paladin (not owned, 350 rubies) → skin-preview-buy tapped → toast 'Skin acquistata e indossata!' visible + button switched to 'Indossata' (screenshot /tmp/it10_buy.png). Restored: equip-lord_frost_warden clicked, toast 'Skin indossata' and card state → 'Indossata'. Social tab: quick-chat panel visible with 'Chat globale' header + quick-chat-messages panel (2 pre-existing globals), quick-chat-input + quick-chat-send; typed 'QA batch4 test 812569' → send → message count 2→3 and the new text is visible in the panel (screenshot /tmp/it10_qc.png). quick-chat-open → chat-screen loaded (route /alliance/chat), channel chip 'Globale' active and the same 3 messages incl. our sent one are visible (screenshot /tmp/it10_chat.png). No red screen/crashes across Battle, Eventi hub, Shop, Preview, Social. Only console noise are pre-existing 401 background polls + pointerEvents RN-web deprecation (unchanged from prior iterations). No deprecated Expo packages introduced. Final QA state left as spec: lord_frost_warden + castle_dragon_keep + army_crimson_legion equipped (backend teardown fixture + FE frost_warden re-equip both ran).
critical_code_review_comments: Cosmetic catalog now cleanly extended to 14 SKUs (added 4 army entries with color/glow). CATALOG in /app/backend/app/domain/cosmetics.py:12 keeps deterministic ordering; BY_KEY lookup is O(1); army fields expose only cosmetic color/glow — no stat leakage. view() returns rubies_now per item plus a resolved deal dict — client can render the shop without extra requests.

daily_deal() uses SHA1(day) mod len(CATALOG) — deterministic per UTC day; end-of-day is computed as (now+1d) midnight, always in the future (<= 24h). Discount enforced at server (price_for + atomic $inc in buy()) — client cannot pass a price hint. Verified: response deal:true and rubies_spent == deal.rubies for today's SKU.
buy() is atomic (single update_one with {rubies:{$gte:price}, owned:{$ne:key}}); auto-equips on success. Purchase receipt written to purchases collection with kind=ruby_spend (audit trail).

equip() validates kind ∈ {lord,castle,army} (400 bad_kind for anything else), verifies BY_KEY[key].kind matches, and requires ownership (403 not_owned); supports key=null to unequip — spec-consistent.

resolved() returns cosmetics.army as {key,name,color,glow} for the client so BattleScene can consume armyBanner without a catalog lookup (see BattleScene.tsx:545 WarBanner render + heraldicColor prop wired from profile).

SkinPreview screen (/app/frontend/app/skin-preview.tsx) drives lord phases via 4 setTimeouts (1500/2600/3300/4600ms) with a cycle counter — cheap and correct; castles/armies use a lightweight setInterval firework. Buy/equip mutations reuse useAction with success toasts and invalidate [cosmetics, profile, store] — UI stays in sync (verified: button flips to 'Indossata' after buy).

QuickChat.tsx correctly gates send by email_verified, trims + resets input on success, and invalidates the chat query (['chat','global:it']) so the just-sent message reappears — confirmed live (count 2→3, text visible). Opens /alliance/chat via quick-chat-open, which is the same channel-aware Chat screen.

Only nit: BattleScene handles armyBanner=null gracefully (no WarBanner rendered) and formation front-line still tints with heraldicColor coming from profile.cosmetics.army.color (falls back to default when null) — good defensive coding.
seed_data_creation: test_buy_deal_deducts_discounted_price tops up 2000 rubies via /api/_test/grant only if balance is below deal.rubies+50, then buys today's daily-deal skin (currently castle_elven_palace, 490 rubies) if not already owned. FE flow additionally bought lord_crimson_paladin (350 rubies) if not owned. Both purchases are permanent — QA rubies balance dropped from 3728 to 2878 during this run. Test module teardown re-equips canonical lord_frost_warden + castle_dragon_keep + army_crimson_legion (verified via GET /profile).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest tests/test_batch4_army_deal_quickchat.py -v (uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). Cosmetic army SKU keys: army_crimson_legion (400, RARE, #B3162B/#FF6A3D — QA owns+equips), army_azure_order (400, RARE, #1F4FB3/#6FB6FF), army_emerald_wardens (550, EPIC, #1F7A3E/#7BE495), army_obsidian_pact (750, LEG, #2A1B3D/#B66CFF). Daily-deal today (UTC) resolves to castle_elven_palace (490 rubies). Shop testIDs: skin-shop, daily-deal, daily-deal-countdown, daily-deal-buy, daily-deal-preview, daily-deal-equip, skins-lord, skins-castle, skins-army, skin-<key>, preview-<key>, buy-<key>, equip-<key>, unequip-<lord|castle|army>. Preview testIDs: skin-preview-screen, skin-preview-stage, skin-preview-name, skin-preview-lord (only for lord skins), skin-preview-castle, skin-preview-banner, skin-preview-buy, skin-preview-equip, skin-preview-close, skin-preview-back. Battle testIDs: battle-scene, army-banner (inside scene, only when player has army skin equipped), formation-proxies, lord-hp-bar, boss-bar, super-gauge. Social: quick-chat, quick-chat-messages, quick-message-<id>, quick-chat-input, quick-chat-send, quick-chat-open (→ /alliance/chat → chat-screen with channel-Globale active). NOTE for future agents: on web, direct URL nav (page.goto('/social')) is more reliable than tab-social clicks when the ResourceBar chip overlays the tab-bar corner — the second run switched to page.goto and it worked immediately. Two ResourceBars live at once — always scope with e.g. get_by_test_id('battle-scene').get_by_test_id('res-rubies-shop') if you need the chip.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. All 5 backend items and 6 frontend items in the request checklist verified end-to-end. Only friction encountered was clicking tab-social when a toast overlay covered the bottom bar; worked around by navigating to /social directly.
